stemMarkdown: In a 500 m race, A finishes in 44 seconds and B finishes in 57 seconds. By how many metres does A beat B? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: B's speed is $\dfrac{500}{57} = 8.7719$ m/s. When A finishes at 44 s, B has covered $8.7719 \times 44 = 385.9649$ m. A therefore beats B by $114.0351$ m.
